line: Bed drawer: the Stay tile now shows the day of the stay, for example "Day 37".
Home is back at the top of the side menu on a computer, with a house icon.
Bed board, movement bars and board cards show the given name in full.
Waitlist is now Waiting list, and dossier is now record.
The officer guide names each step up to Arrived at ward. Counts read 1 day and 2 days.
Stay figures say who they cover and write days in full. Forecast alerts name their unit.
Statistics and Handover headings name their page, and the ward table has a key for site codes.
Labels are in sentence case, and refused actions are named in plain words, not codes.
Referral checks say gender mix, matching the bed screens.
The Help glossary now spells out AWST, CAMHS, HDU, KPI, MHERL and PIR.
A community team now sees an inpatient's observation level as Withheld, not General.
A device with its clock set wrong no longer cuts a role short or keeps it open too long.
Transport booking no longer needs a CAD number for a ward escort or family, and Save stays in view.
The Ward page now has two tabs, Ward home and Decisions. Place or move opens the bed board.
On a computer, the mouse wheel now carries on scrolling the page past side panels and lists.
Ward boards show your part in tomorrow's forecast, and Home links straight to it.
The coloured page header now stays a full-width band under notes and banners, on every device.
Opening the app on another desk no longer flashes the coordinator's page first.
Waiting and All EDs are back in the coordinator's side menu on a computer.
Forms ask less: optional answers no longer block sending, and a disabled Save says why.
